sourceProfile.display: APPNP iteration template / alpha=.1 / K=3 / no task head
sourceProfile.selected_configuration: explicit static module profile; not a runtime observation

sourceFacts: One representative recurrence is shown with K=3 declared example repeats. Feedback edges carry next H, not fresh task logits.
Edge Dropout occurs before the loop and is shared within a forward. Restart is always the same latent_features_2, never the latest H.
Normalized topology is external at the chosen module boundary; torch_sparse.spmm remains a library boundary.
Graph ranks only allocate space. Explicit edges supply real operands; no upstream code is imported or executed.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
